name: Reaxys
tagline: Reaxys searches a database of chemical reactions, substances, and properties drawn from journals and patents, and suggests plausible synthesis routes for a target compound. Chemists and pharma researchers use it to check whether a reaction has been tried before and to plan a synthesis route without manually combing through decades of literature.
